pictures.scene: Gaudenzio Ferrari, Concert of Angels — the whole dome full of angels singing and playing on every instrument, exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem, praise your God, O Zion
pictures.name: pd_ferrari_sion

pictures.scene: Jacob Jordaens, Suffer the Little Children to Come Unto Me — the mothers bringing their children up to Christ and His hand laid on them, He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you
pictures.name: pd_jordaens_kinderen

pictures.scene: Ivan Shishkin, Rye — the ripe wheat standing shoulder-high along the quiet cart path, He makes peace at your borders, He fills you with the finest wheat
pictures.name: pd_shishkin_tarwe

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Annunciation — Gabriel rushing in headlong with the dove blazing in the light before him, He sends forth His command to the earth, His word runs swiftly
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_bevel

pictures.scene: Hendrick Avercamp, Ice Landscape — the snow lying on the roofs and the townsfolk out on the frozen water, He spreads the snow like wool, He scatters the frost like ashes
pictures.name: pd_avercamp_sneeuw

pictures.scene: Willem van de Velde the Younger, A Ship on the High Seas Caught by a Squall — the vessel laid right over in the breaking sea under a black sky, He casts forth His hail like pebbles, who can withstand His icy blast
pictures.name: pd_velde_hagel

pictures.scene: Alexei Savrasov, The Rooks Have Returned — the snow melting into standing water and the rooks back in the birches beside the church, He sends forth His word and melts them, and the waters flow
pictures.name: pd_savrasov_dooi

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Prophet Ezekiel — the prophet turning with the scroll in his hand and the other hand thrown open, He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_woord

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua Passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — the priests carrying the ark down into the river bed under the pillar of light, He has done this for no other nation
pictures.name: pd_west_volk

pictures.scene: John Singleton Copley, The Ascension — Christ rising into the open sky with His arms thrown wide and the disciples below with their hands lifted, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_copley_halleluja

lines.text: For He strengthens the bars of your gates
and blesses the children within you.
He makes peace at your borders;
He fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends forth His command to the earth;
He spreads the snow like wool;
He scatters the frost like ashes;
He casts forth His hail like pebbles.
Who can withstand His icy blast?
He sends forth His word and melts them;
He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
He declares His word to Jacob,
His statutes and judgments to Israel.
He has done this for no other nation;
they do not know His judgments.
